description: Submarine cables Indian and Atlantic Ocean is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Elizabeth Cobbett. Original methodology that collects submarine fibre-optic cable data in the Atlantic and Indian Oceans to yield significant empirical findings on global connectivity. Coverage: national (IN); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. Formats: XML. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0 1.0. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support communication-network and digital-infrastructure studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
